hook.name: TradingFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a 5% trading fee on every swap (0.5% commission to treasury, 4.5% to token creator via RevenueVault), using beforeSwapReturnDelta for exact-input buys and afterSwapReturnDelta for sells and exact-output buys. Pools must be registered by the LaunchVault to have fees enabled; unregistered pools swap without any fee.
